title: AirPods Pro 3 and more just got new firmware release in beta - 9to5Mac
summary: Apple has released new AirPods beta firmware today for developers and public beta testers. Ahead of iOS 27’s launch next month , Apple continues preparing new AirPods firmware that’s expected to ship alongside the new iPhone release.
